name: Namchow Food Group (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
summary: Operating out of Shanghai, China, Namchow Food Group (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. specializes in the bakery and confectionery industry. The company provides a comprehensive selection of ingredients and products, such as baking-specific oils and fats, whipped creams, a variety of imported dairy goods, and ready-to-use frozen dough and fillings. This enterprise is a division of Namchow (Cayman Islands) Holding Corp.
